services.title: Designer Blouses
services.description: Signature Alite cut, Prince cut (padded and non-padded), double Katori, Bombay cut, Sabyasachi bridal cuts, and backless dori styling.

services.title: Salwar Suits & Kurtis
services.description: Straight cut, Nayra cut, Alia cut V-Empire, flared Anarkalis, Pakistani suits with designer mori, cigarette pants, and palazzos.

services.title: Bridal & Lehenga Cholis
services.description: Heavy zari bridal lehenga choli tailoring, kalidar stitching, cancan net insertion, dupatta setting, and festive western gowns.

services.title: Saree Fall, Pico & Alterations
services.description: Fine saree fall stitching, zig-zag interlock pico, saree kuchu thread tassels, handmade bridal latkans, and precision alterations.

reviews.comment: Accurate shoulder and bust fitting without needing repeated alterations. Having matching cotton astar and falls right at the shop saves so much time in Rajarhat.
reviews.ownerReply: Thank you for trusting us with your festive sarees, Srabani ji.

reviews.comment: Cooperative staff and reliable delivery dates even during Durga Puja rush. My padded Prince cut blouses turned out neat with zero puckering.
Very convenient location right opposite Bazaar Kolkata near Rajarhat Thana. Clean finishing on Pakistani suit mori and palazzo trousers.
Needed an urgent blouse stitched before a wedding in New Town. Delivered on time with matching dori and handmade tassels.
